titleSupport: No independent title field asserted; caption is the primary copy.
description:
Nuclear reactors before humans existed.

Roughly two billion years ago, natural reaction zones at Oklo, in what is now Gabon, sustained nuclear fission. Ancient uranium, concentrated deposits and groundwater made it possible.

Heat, not electricity. Geology, without machinery.

Original illustrations and AI-generated narration.

#Oklo #NaturalNuclearReactor #DeepTime
firstComment: The uranium was the fuel. Water helped slow the neutrons. Geology brought the conditions together. Starts and stops are inferred from one studied zone, not an ancient clock anyone watched.
